seasons.review_body: The Uncanny Counter premiered on OCN on November 28, 2020, and ran to January 24, 2021, becoming the highest-rated drama in OCN's broadcast history with an 11-percent finale rating. Based on a webtoon by Jang Yi, the series follows disabled high school student So Mun, who joins a covert team of demon hunters operating out of a noodle restaurant. Yeom Hye-ran's supporting performance earned the Baeksang Best Supporting Actress award in 2021. The show blends action choreography with found-family character work, sustaining momentum across its 16-episode run. IMDb audiences rated it 8.0, and the mix of comic-book energy with genuine emotional stakes stands out as a chief virtue.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: Mun's birthday precipitates his bonding with a spirit and his first contact with the Counter team. The premiere efficiently establishes the supernatural rules and the noodle-shop cover without front-loading exposition. The show announces its tonal blend early, balancing humor with violence in close proximity.
episode_reviews.the_moment: So Mun's first Counter ability manifesting mid-threat - the scene that defines what the series is physically capable of and willing to show.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 16
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves the season’s central threat and reaches the 11-percent viewership peak. The action set-pieces land, and the emotional throughlines with So Mun’s family get sufficient resolution without sentimentality, delivering a satisfying close to the Counter team’s first case.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final confrontation with Myeong-hwi - the payoff for a season's worth of accumulated stakes.

bollymeter.basis: 64-percent Rotten Tomatoes from critics; all four RT reviewers noted meaningful decline from Season 1; viewership averaged 1.4 million versus Season 1's 2.4 million. Critics cited pacing issues and weak writing as the primary failures.

pull_quotes.text: This 2nd season is good enough. But it's also a reminder that K-dramas are traditionally made to finish after one season.
There was a time when we cared about these colourful counters and their zippy duels with evil spirits - those days are gone.

seasons.review_body: Counter Punch aired on tvN from July 29 to September 3, 2023, with a new set of antagonists and a compressed 12-episode run. Critics scored it at 64 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, a significant drop from Season 1's 96 percent. Pierce Conran at the South China Morning Post and Jae-Ha Kim both noted the fundamental problem: the show was designed to conclude in one season, and the continuation carries the creative debt. Viewership averaged 1.433 million versus Season 1's 2.379 million, confirming audience attrition. Ready Steady Cut's Nathan Sartain offered a more positive reading, praising the action choreography and the fresh antagonist design. The general critical consensus placed Season 2 as a watchable but unnecessary extension - functional as action entertainment, hollow as a dramatic continuation.
seasons.season_over_season: Moves from a tightly structured origin story to a broader ensemble battle; the 96-to-64-percent RT swing and viewership decline track the creative cost of continuing a story built to end.
